revision_summary: Two quote/citation fixes and one internal-consistency fix are needed before approval: (1) The address_homeowner quote in script_coverage is tagged at the wrong timestamp — 'I have you at 36554 Stony Point Road in Crystalville' actually occurs around 00:30-00:38, not 00:12 (00:12 is the rep's 'looking at solar for the home... how are you doing' line). Correct the ts. (2) script_coverage's co_owner entry quotes 01:40 as 'Is there anybody else on the title with you, or is it just you?' but the transcript at 01:40 is actually 'Okay. And then is it a metal roof as well?' — the title question is at 01:52 (roof question is 01:35-01:39). Fix ts to 01:52. (3) Resolve the internal inconsistency between script_coverage marking button_up as 'skipped' and cherry_pick_moments correctly describing it as a partial button-up (live-request confirmation, no-driving reminder, and email instruction were all delivered) — change script_coverage status to 'partial' with a supporting quote from 07:48-08:00. (4) In cherry_pick_moments entries with a non-null alternative_hypothesis (00:54 interest reason, 02:22 bill anchor), explicitly adjudicate between the reactive-failure and strategic-deferral hypotheses with reasoning per analysis_directives.strategic_vs_reactive, rather than presenting both and defaulting to the negative read in coaching_implication. (5) Correct the schema_reference in the 06:16 time-zone cherry_pick_moment — protocols.how_did_you_get_my_number is about contact-source suspicion, not time-zone logistics; recharacterize as a general positive-legitimacy moment without forcing a specific protocol citation.
